title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
study_context: Methodological analysis of finite-sample model-selection criteria and performance evaluation.
population_or_data: Methodological analysis of finite-sample model-selection criteria and performance evaluation.
main_findings: Variance in a finite-sample model-selection criterion can lead to overfitting of that criterion and selection bias in subsequent performance evaluation.
limitations: Selected-page review only: PDF p.1, Abstract. Text extracted and page visually checked on 2026-10-07.
Transfer to cardiac WSI MIL requires qualification.
does_not_establish: Does not quantify bias in SMC or prove that selection bias alone caused the difference between earlier checkpoint-selected and later independent-test results.
relevance_to_project: Separate decisions about models, checkpoints and cutoffs from the observations used to evaluate those decisions.
